sources.title: Rashik24/Mistral-Instruct-Bangla · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Mistral-Instruct-Bangla model is intended for a range of applications where understanding and generating Bengali text is crucial. This includes but is not limited to machine translation, content creation, sentiment analysis, and language understanding tasks in Bengali.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 - GGUF - GitHub
sources.snippet: The Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 Large Language Model (LLM) is an improved instruct fine-tuned version of Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1. For full details of this model please read our paper and release blog post.
